description:

Police took Trenton Futrell into custody after the man allegedly berated police who were attempting to give him a simple ticket for speeding 10mph over the speed limit. Officers let the behavior slide until they discovered the man had a traffic warrant. Then, when officers went to arrest the man, a chaotic scene unfolded.
